items.title: Conrad "Connie" Jones Interview, 1981-09-01
items.q: But he did a couple of records with Sharky, Over the Waves and things like that, that he played tuba on.

ctx.x: But I mean that's just, I don't remember, when you say it was Sharky in person I don't remember him playing anything but string bass. No I don't either.
But he did a couple of records with Sharky, Over the Waves and things like that, that he played tuba on. He played really good.
You ever get hired for churches? The tape's running out anyway.
